title: Two etale coordinate Kunneth routes before a trace
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y proper, W=X×_Y X with projections p1,p2, and L∈D(Y_et,A), M∈D(X_et,A). Use the ordinary unbounded module derived categories and specified maps of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data]. Write F=Rf*. The composite orderedProjection(f,FM,f*L), then F(comparison(L,M) inverse), then directComparison equals the composite ordinaryProjection(f,M,Ff*L), then F of identity tensor exchange1(f*L), then F of orderedProjection(p1,M,p2*f*L). No trace or rank-one hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the transpose equality for the two routes and use injectivity of the hom-equivalence of the derived adjunction pull f ⊣ push f. The transpose theorem is exactly the pullback-counit form of the displayed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem coordinateKunnethFactorization [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (orderedProjectionIso A f ((push A f).obj M) ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫
        (push A f).map (comparison A f L M).inv ≫
        (directComparison A f).hom.app _ =
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M).app
          ((push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ≫
        (push A f).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
              (exchange1 A f ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫
            (orderedProjectionIso A (pullback.fst f f) M
              ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))).hom)
